text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 loss. The evidence shows that there was a tree-cover loss of about 0.7 hectares within the asset in 2023, as mapped by Hansen/UMD. This loss is corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which agrees on the entire event area. The JRC map confirms that the area was forest in 2020, supporting the observation of tree-cover loss in 2023.
